newsitem.title: UK: MAM down as Kleinwort advises take profits.
newsitem.headline: MAM down as Kleinwort advises take profits.

text.p: Shares in Mercury Asset Management Plc dipped on Thursday as analysts at Kleinwort Benson advised investors to take profits in the stock after its recent strong run, traders said.
The stock was down 14-1/2p at 12.28 stg by 1216 GMT, after on Wednesday touching an intraday record of 12.69 stg -- up from around 900p at the end of July.

The surge in MAM shares in the past week, spurred by rising markets, has boosted the market value of the company to the point where it is poised to re-join the FTSE 100 index of leading shares in next week'sreshuffle of the index's members. Yet Kleinwort analysts pointed out that shares often underperform in the wake of coming into the FTSE, traders said.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
